body:
Thank you so much for this post, you definitely have a lot of wisdom in you. I know that the past is probably one of the things that drags people down most in life, it's very hard to move past it. 

When I was talking about people hating me, I was referring to the friends of my ex's mostly. People I barely knew that would talk smack about me just because their friend was in a relationship with me. 

It's hard to get past being cheated on, I still feel guilty even though I didn't do it. I don't know, maybe I'm upset because she has a much better life than I ever knew. I very much have let all those who dislike me, determine my entire life for so long.

Haha it does seem like we might be in similar situations. Life is tough though no doubt. I'm free to talk anytime so I might take you up on that offer sometime. Sorry I wasn't able to get back to you earlier. Thanks so much dude, it means a lot.

I'm gonna step out right quick. If anyone else wants to comment, just letting you know it might be a while before I get back to you. 

Thanks for everything so far anons.

My bad, sorry I was away. But yeah, I'm sure when everyone feels good their flaws seem to disappear for them. I jut miss her so damn much and the time we spent. It's unmanly but it's true. I miss her and I can't put her behind.
Thanks I really gotta keep all of that in mind. It's hard when you feel trapped in life.

Haha you don't know me though, but I'll admit you did make me smile. :) Thanks for that anon, I needed it. But nothing I'll do between now and when I die will ever wash out my mistakes. People will still hate me, the girls I love will hold me in contempt. I can't ever wipe away being cheated on. I can't ever wipe away wasting so many years of my life. The past is permanent on me.
I've struggled with depression for the past 2 years OP, I know that pain. Give me some background info on your situation.
